title: Modern PHP 8 Essentials
description: Write and run modern PHP 8 directly in your browser. Master typed functions, associative arrays, match expressions, classes, PDO security habits, and an auto-graded capstone.
outcomes: Write clean PHP 8 with strict types, string interpolation, and null coalescing
Use modern match expressions, foreach loops, and array_map/array_filter
Build typed functions and PHP 8 classes with constructor property promotion
Prevent SQL injection and XSS using prepared statements and htmlspecialchars
Pass an auto-graded PHP 8 capstone challenge in the browser
